capabilities: Annotate words with inline translations using {value|translation} syntax
Translate selected words into plugin syntax via a Translate command
Attach images to words with same-named links
Practice selected or all vocabulary with voiceover playback
Configure Google or custom translation and text-to-speech providers
extras: Translation and voiceover do not work without either a Google Cloud API key or a locally run Translator service; the README markets the plugin as offline and free but the network services still need setup.
intentEvidence: Forget expensive apps like Quizlet, Readlang, and others. Memodack is a simpler, free alternative
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to mark up foreign-language words with translations and drill them, and dedicated apps like Quizlet are paid and separate from your notes.
